title: Cops seize P367,000 in 'shabu' in Dipolog City buy-bust

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Police operatives arrested a high-value drug suspect, seizing from him around P367,200 worth of suspected meth or shabu during a joint buy-bust operation in Barangay Miputak, Dipolog City on Tuesday evening, October 20. Police Lt. Col. Shellamie Chang, information chief of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 9, said the operation took place at around 9:49 p.m. in Purok Mahogany, Barangay Miputak.
